import test from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import {createProgression,readBest,saveBest,readGodMode,saveGodMode,PROGRESS_KEY,BEST_KEY,GOD_KEY} from '../dist/2d/progression.js';
function storage(seed={}){const values=new Map(Object.entries(seed));return {getItem:key=>values.get(key)??null,setItem:(key,value)=>values.set(key,value)}}
test('the sky gate requires both chapters, in either order, and survives reload',()=>{for(const order of [[0,1],[1,0]]){const s=storage(),p=createProgression(s);assert.equal(p.canEnter(2),false);p.complete(order[0]);assert.equal(p.canEnter(2),false);p.complete(order[1]);assert.equal(p.canEnter(2),true);assert.deepEqual(createProgression(s).snapshot().completed,[true,true,false]);assert.equal(p.canEnter(-1),false);assert.equal(p.canEnter(3),false);assert.equal(p.canEnter('2'),false)}});
test('only genuine positive numeric legacy finish scores migrate',()=>{const s=storage({[BEST_KEY]:JSON.stringify({0:1200,1:1800})});assert.equal(createProgression(s).canEnter(2),true);assert.equal(JSON.parse(s.getItem(PROGRESS_KEY)).version,1);for(const value of [null,[],{0:0,1:10},{0:'300',1:10},{0:-1,1:10}])assert.equal(createProgression(storage({[BEST_KEY]:JSON.stringify(value)})).canEnter(2),false)});
test('corrupt or unavailable storage remains playable and safe',()=>{const denied={getItem(){throw Error('denied')},setItem(){throw Error('denied')}};for(const s of [null,denied,storage({[PROGRESS_KEY]:'{broken',[BEST_KEY]:'{broken'}),storage({[PROGRESS_KEY]:'null',[BEST_KEY]:'[]'})]){const p=createProgression(s);assert.equal(p.canEnter(2),false);assert.deepEqual(readBest(s),{});p.complete(0);p.complete(1);assert.equal(p.canEnter(2),true);assert.equal(readGodMode(s),false);assert.doesNotThrow(()=>saveGodMode(s,true));assert.doesNotThrow(()=>saveBest(s,{0:5}))}});
test('god preference cannot grant progression and defaults to off',()=>{const s=storage();assert.equal(readGodMode(s),false);saveGodMode(s,true);assert.equal(readGodMode(s),true);assert.equal(createProgression(s).canEnter(2),false);s.setItem(GOD_KEY,'"true"');assert.equal(readGodMode(s),false)});
